svg.desc: Left: nested populations. All impressions contain the clicked impressions, which contain the converted ones; a naive CVR model trains on clicked impressions but is served on all of them, which is sample selection bias. Right: ESMM shares embeddings between a CTR tower and a CVR tower and multiplies them into pCTCVR, trained with a click loss and a click-and-convert loss on all impressions.

svg.text: ESMM trains pCTR and pCTCVR on the entire impression space; pCVR is their ratio, never fitted on clicks alone.

svg.text: Example: pCTR = 0.08, pCVR = 0.15 → pCTCVR = 0.012 conversions per impression. Weak where pCTR is small.
